info.title: API.SH: Notino
info.description: The Notino API from API.SH: public Notino data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
What a Notino shop's search box suggests for a few letters: matching collections, brands and categories with their links, and products with id, code, description and image.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/notino-autocomplete

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

products.title: DIOR Sauvage
products.description: After Shave Balsam mit Pumpe für Herren

get.description:
One Notino product with every variant (size or shade): name, brand, collection, annotation, categories, price, previous price, lowest price of the last 30 days, unit price, stock and availability, EAN, product codes, images, videos, characteristics, ingredients, usage and warnings, scent notes for perfumes, perfumers, rating with the per-star breakdown and review counts, delivery options, current campaigns, brand details (manufacturer, address) and the product's pages on the other Notino shops.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/notino-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Product id (the number after `p-` in a product link) or a product link; a link's shop sets `country`.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Shop for an id (de default; see search).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Reviews of a Notino product (all its variants, from every Notino shop, translated where the shop translates them): rating, title, text, date, reviewer's first name, variant, likes and dislikes, original language and text, pros and cons, photos, with the total, the per-star counts and the counts per variant. Sort, filter by stars, by variant, to reviews with photos or to untranslated reviews. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/notino-reviews

parameters.name: variant_id
parameters.description: Only reviews of this variant (`variants[].id` of the product).

parameters.name: original_only
parameters.description: `true` to leave out reviews translated from other shops.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search one Notino shop, or list a category, brand or collection page: product id, brand, name, size/annotation, link, image, price, previous price, unit price, current discount code, rating, review count, stock level, variants, new/sponsored flags, with the total, the page count, the shop's filters (category, brand, type, for whom, offers, rating...) with counts, the price range and breadcrumbs. Narrow with `filters` (option values from `filters[].options[].value`), a price range and a sort. A search for a brand name answers with that brand's page. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/notino-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words. Either `q` or `path` is required.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: A category, brand or collection path or link on the shop, e.g. `dior`, `dior/sauvage2015` or `https://www.notino.de/parfums/` (from `breadcrumbs[].path` or a shop link).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Shop: de (default), at, ch, fr, it, es, uk, ie, nl, be, pt, cz, sk, pl, hu, ro, bg, hr, si, se, dk, fi, gr, ua. A shop link in `path` sets it.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Filter option values, comma separated, from `filters[].options[].value` of a response (e.g. a brand, a category or a rating option).

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Lowest price in the shop's currency.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Highest price in the shop's currency.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `relevance` (default), `bestsellers`, `price_asc`, `price_desc`, `rating` or `newest`. Sorted searches include every match, not only the most relevant ones.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

items.name: Sauvage
items.annotation: Eau de Parfum nachfüllbar für Herren

get.description:
Notino's own stores and pickup points that hold a product variant, with the stock level, the earliest pickup time and the store's description. Stores exist in some countries only (for example cz, sk, pl, hu, ro, bg); elsewhere the list is empty.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/notino-stores

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
